name: interego-telemetry
description: Metadata-only LLM session, tool and agent observations in your private Interego xAPI records.

interface.shortDescription: Private LLM telemetry and HyperMarkdown reports
interface.longDescription: Capture supported Codex lifecycle metadata in Interego. Requires connecting the Interego MCP server and reviewing hook trust. Prompts, responses, arguments, transcripts and credentials are excluded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open my Interego LLM activity interface at https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com/llm-telemetry using render_hmd.
